verdicts.why: تک is the postposition glossed 'up to', which 'reach the top' does not render, but the row belongs to the sentence.
'not' is fused into 'didn't want to know' in the seed, and the row still glosses that negation.
تو is glossed 'then', which 'Even if he wanted to' does not render, but the row belongs to its LEGO.
شخص is glossed 'person' but the seed says 'someone', so the word is back-glossed inside its own LEGO.
The row says 'had to' where the seed says 'needed to run', so the sentence's own words disagree with the gloss.
'کر دیا' is glossed 'did', a light verb the seed's 'started to think' does not render separately.
很 is glossed '(it's)', and the seed has 'I think that it's interesting', so the row belongs to the sentence but is a parenthetical back-gloss.
完全 is glossed 'completely' but the seed renders 'at all', and the LEGO covers the same words.
The gloss 'is (in the middle of)' adds a parenthetical to the seed's 'is changing', which the sentence does not render.
'Is' is clitic-fused in the seed's "He's trying".
'Are' is clitic-fused in the seed's "We're friends".
The row says "I've got more to learn" while the seed asks 'Have you got more to learn', and no single correct value is forced.
不 is glossed 'not' but the seed has "don't mind at all", so the negation is fused.
'is' is clitic-fused in the seed's "she's my friend".
The row says 'Have to' while the seed and LEGO say 'must work hard', a synonym mismatch.
The row's 'something / thing' is a slash gloss, and its LEGO pairs 东西 with the whole sentence, which is malformed.
那时候 is glossed 'At the time', which the seed 'I thought that was a good idea' does not render, but the row belongs to its LEGO.
'is going to' is fused into "what's going to happen" in the seed.
'A long time' is a literal gloss of 长时间, and the seed renders it as 'How long have you been'.
这 is glossed 'This', which the seed's "It's interesting that" does not render, but the row belongs to its LEGO.
